title: RAW retained dew feeds flesh and separately generates a gem within qualified recipient accounts
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. design.mechanism: The whole dew paragraph contrasts outward subtlety with strong effects, then follows a qualified oyster episode: at night in spring the oysters open, receive dew between the shells, and hold it. That retained dew feeds/fattens the flesh; incorporation with inner parts is separately stated to breed a pearl. The paragraph also assigns fertility/growth to earth/corn and feeding to ravens' young while whitish before black. Preserve the retained input reference, different outcomes and positive time/developmental qualifications without inventing exclusive prohibitions outside those scopes.
design.contrast: R1: apparent subtlety means weak efficacy, so the named effects cannot occur in the account. R2: merely approaching or touching the outer shell is equivalent to reception, retention and incorporation. R3: feeding existing flesh and producing a gem are the same outcome, or every feeding act creates a pearl. R4: all dew is wholly transformed into pearl or an unchanged measured parcel is conserved across every effect. R5: night/spring or whitish-before-black qualifications imply an unwritten no-feeding rule at every other time. R6: the source gives a modern demonstrated pearl-forming mechanism rather than a historical claim.
design.prediction: A faithful whole account must retain the same introduced dew through reception and holding, distinguish feeding/fattening existing flesh from the pearl generation linked to incorporation, and retain the separate earth/corn and young-raven duties. Removing retention/incorporation or swapping those relations changes the pearl explanation. Time and developmental phrases qualify their named recipients; they do not supply an exclusive universal feeding schedule. A dew/oyster/pearl list misses the connected process and the contrast between material appearance and attributed power.
whole_source_duties: Full paragraph85 begins with dew as an airy, outwardly subtle substance but strong in working and virtue. This is a concessive contrast, not an explicit causal law that subtlety produces strength.
Dew sprinkles the earth and makes it plenteous; flour, pith and marrow increase in corn/grains. These plant/earth duties cannot be omitted from a claimed whole-paragraph synopsis.

It fattens and brings forth broad oysters and other sea shellfish, especially dew of spring. Preserve the source wording without silently deciding whether brings forth means reproduction, emergence or growth.

At night in spring oysters open themselves toward dew, receive it between two shells and hold/keep it. These are positive qualified assertions; the text does not explicitly forbid opening or feeding at other times.

That dew held/kept feeds the flesh and makes it fat. By its incorporation with the fish's inner parts it breeds the precious gem called Margarita. Keep the flesh, inner parts and new gem distinct, without introducing a measured partition or asserting total conversion of all dew.

The retained-dew anaphora is written; it does not establish unchanged chemistry or quantitative mass conservation. Feeding and incorporation-associated generation are separately expressed but not a timed experimental sequence with measured endpoints.

The closing Gregory-attributed statement says dew feeds/sustains birds of ravens while whitish in feathers before black. This is a developmentally qualified recipient claim, not evidence that feeding ceases once black.

Adjacent83/84 concern rainbow generation/colours and an attributed final-judgment sign; they are not evidence for pearl formation. Other retained chapter offers such as587 rain harm,588 perception,591 glass,593 lead and594 relative element remain separate.
